name: Uranium Finance v2 pair k-check miscalculation

classification.summary: The v2 UraniumPair.swap() scaled its balance adjustment by 10000 for the new fee but kept Uniswap's 1000**2 factor on the reserve side of the constant-product require, making the post-swap invariant check 100x too weak and letting the attacker take ~99% of each pair's reserves for a token dust input.

loss.notes: Migrated from legacy lossUsd/lossOther. The legacy corpus did not consistently distinguish gross from net loss or record valuation provenance.

limitations: Target identity and code history came from the v1 snapshot row originally at protocols/uranium-finance.json; no semantic revalidation was inherited.
The executing code artifact and its code hash have not been established in structured evidence.
One or more target block, transaction, ordering, or creator anchors remain unresolved.

sources.note: onchain review: victim is the v2 WBNB/BUSD pair 0x9b9bad4c returned by UraniumFactory 0xa943ea143cd7e79806d670f4a7cf08f8922a454f at the attack block, created 2021-04-16 by 0x659aab4b03053fe60002778efe104562a3909762 (the v2 migration), not by attack sender 0xc47bdd0a; the single tx drained several sibling pairs sharing the same pair code
